title: Work at height course: what do you learn?
lines: Need a work at height certificate? Here's what the course covers.
Laws and regulations, and gear to prevent and arrest falls.
Ladders, roofs, lifting platforms and scaffolds, by type of work.
Most important: hands-on practice, not just theory.
At the end, a certificate signed by a certified instructor.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
